sonnet.problem: The right answer is clearly the longest (about 62 characters, against about 52 and 44 for the wrong answers). It also repeats the verse's own wording ('earnestness', 'in the sight of God'), while the wrong answers are plain and modern, so it stands out.
sonnet.rule: All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone. None are silly. ... Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. None should sound more like the Bible, or more modern, than the others.
